newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BET Holdings started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BET Holdings started.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst John Reidy confirmed that he has initiated coverage of BET Holdings Inc with an outperform rating, and said it was a well-positioned cable television company.
-- "(BET chief executive officer) Robert Johnson is a very proven businessman with strong aspirations to build a larger Afro-American oriented enterprise with BET as its core network," Reidy said.
BET is an acronym for Black Entertainment Television.
